title: Rules judge: structural checks
spec: Add src/judge/rules.ts: RulesJudge with configurable minChars (default 80), forbidden phrases (default: "as an AI", "I cannot", "not found in the cited source" only counts as pass when the spec cites a source that the deliverable names), and a "quotes the source" bonus when the deliverable contains a quoted string plus an http(s) URL from the spec. Verdict scores 0, 0.5 or 1 with one reason per rule that fired. Never calls a model.
done: The labelled mini-corpus in the public test gets the expected pass/fail and reasons.
